strong_reference_factorization.why_raw_k1_is_not_sufficient: raw K1/F1 has only 1824 Acc19 state bits and no K8 grouping/descriptor machinery, whereas every selected candidate has 14592 Acc19 state bits and K8 control

also_required_unquantified: mask queue or equivalent bitset walker

weight_read_ruling.evidence: raw K8/F1 reduces reads from 1010523752 to 391666724, but service cycles remain exactly 1010523752; only descriptor geometry changes total cycles by 1.028612929x
weight_read_ruling.correct_interpretation: read reduction is a bandwidth/energy opportunity; cycle reduction comes from F simultaneous context updates plus separately identified parent and grouping effects

p0_findings.title: The automatic F2/F4 advance gate uses a weak K1 reference and does not isolate the claimed held-weight multicast mechanism
p0_findings.evidence: M225 advances F2 at 1.802367x and F4 at 2.248493x versus raw K1/F1. That reference has one-eighth the context state and lacks K8 grouping. With the same parent, same K8 state and same grouping, multicast alone is only 1.473619x for F2 and 1.838372x for F4, below the frozen 1.5x and 2.0x thresholds.
p0_findings.impact: The exact trace ledger remains valid, but advance_f2_to_matched_rtl_dc=true and advance_f4_to_matched_rtl_dc=true cannot be interpreted as mechanism-specific performance admissions.
p0_findings.required_action: Issue a correction overlay. Keep raw K1/F1 only as the conventional end-to-end reference; add raw K8/F1 as the equal-context-capacity combined reference and spatial K8/F1 as the multicast-isolation reference. Mark both isolated multicast threshold checks false. Parameterized RTL/DC may still proceed as exploratory pricing of the combined parent-plus-multicast engine because the capacity-matched combined factors are 1.752230x and 2.185947x.

p1_findings.finding: The production resource minimum counts Acc19 state but does not quantify the 768-bit held-weight register or the K-by-C presence and sign state.
p1_findings.required_action: Bind these bits and their update ports in the matched DC contract rather than calling K*96*19 the complete added state.

p1_findings.finding: The 256-bit activation scan charge is not yet an executable mask-builder and unique-source enumeration schedule.
p1_findings.required_action: M226 must demonstrate that the mask store, source walker and replay queue sustain the claimed service issue rate under stalls without hidden scan bubbles.

p1_findings.finding: The production screen counts residual presence but does not seal a signed replay ledger; spatial mode contains 21043777 negative events and temporal mode contains 4236286.
p1_findings.required_action: Carry separate presence and sign masks into RTL and prove signed Acc19 updates with VCS/SVA and a bit-exact reference miter.

p1_findings.finding: F2 and F4 add 2x and 4x signed event-add lanes; speedup per lane is 0.9012 and 0.5621 versus raw K1, which is not an area-efficiency result.
p1_findings.required_action: Select only after matched 3 ns DC and SAIF/PTPX, including control/state and the same SRAM interface. Report throughput/area and energy, not cycle ratio alone.

p1_findings.finding: The payload covers ten binary stage-0/1/2 FC1 modules over ten samples; two nonbinary stage-3 FC1 modules remain conventional.
p1_findings.required_action: Keep complete_fc1, complete_ffn, system_speedup and headline false until the fallback is composed into the cycle simulator.

p2_findings.finding: All sampled widths divide K8, so partial-row tail behavior is not exercised.
p2_findings.required_action: Add directed tail, empty-mask, all-eight, mixed-sign and backpressure cases to M226 VCS.

p2_findings.finding: One group descriptor is conservatively charged per output block even though a physical implementation may retain it across blocks.
p2_findings.required_action: Either preserve the fail-closed charge or prove descriptor residency before taking any overlap credit.

review_summary: M225 is an exact and useful opportunity screen, not a failed idea. Its 100-file arithmetic and sample distribution reproduce exactly, and it does not mistake saved weight reads for service cycles. The blocking issue is attribution and admission fairness: 1.802x/2.248x combine K8 grouping, spatial-parent reduction and multicast while comparing against a smaller K1 state machine. The combined engine still has 1.752x/2.186x opportunity versus equal-capacity raw K8/F1, so exploratory matched RTL/DC is justified; multicast alone is 1.474x/1.838x and does not pass the frozen mechanism thresholds.
